香獐子！

没错了，前方灌木丛那一只棕红色的身影就是香獐子，也叫原麝，李青山万万没想到，刚刚还心心念念的香獐子，如今就这么出现在了自己面前。

只不过，这距离稍微远了一些。

“山哥，要不要用枪？”二壮憨厚道。

“你是不是虎？”

李青山皱了皱眉头，开口道：“这一枪下去，香獐子肯定应激，这东西可胆小的很，一旦被枪打中就算是没死都得吓死了，就是弓箭能不用就不要用！”

“要想活捉这小玩意，得动一动脑筋和技术才行！”

俗话说的好，猎百獐不如活一麝，有不少猎人都能活捉香獐子，但香獐子被活捉后运送到目的地前，死亡率还是达到了七成，剩下三成到了目的地估计也死了，除了极少部分放与园林内的少部分可能尚且存活，当做观赏所用。

“山哥，这东西不用弓箭，不用枪，怎么活捉？”

“难不成，还得让咱们追上去活捉？”

“咱们也追不上啊，大黄也不一定追得上吧？”

赵红旗望着丛林内的香獐子，开口道。

“想要活捉这小东西，绳套索，围网，麻醉，幼崽引诱都可以，其中这麻醉活捉最为麻烦，也最为考验技术，对于一些猎人来说是最难的一种方式，但是对于极少一部分猎人来说，却是效率最高的一种方式。”

“只要能在老林子里面找到曼陀罗和草乌这两种中药，通过配比熬制，最后涂在香獐子爱吃的蔷薇属植物上面，香獐子只要吃了就会晕过去，到时候咱们直接过去捡走便是了。”

“之所以说，这东西最难。”

“难在这两种中药的调配，不过我刚好会调配，咱们不要惊动这只香獐子，既然他被咱们在这附近发现了，说明活动范围也就是在这附近，这两日咱们好好准备准备，想办法找一找这两种草药，实在不行就用套索。”

“一定要将这只香獐子给活捉了。”

李青山开口道。

这可是关乎于自己养殖场的大计划，也是年前几个大计划其中的一个重要计划。

除此之外，如今迫切的需求就是给全家老少换一身合身的衣裳！

毕竟，在吃的上面已经解决了。

再盖三间大瓦房，但是这个三间大瓦房的面积肯定要比一般人建的要大，如今是57年，国家对于宅基地的面积尚未有什么硬性规定，你能审批下来，只要不太过分，可以说想盖多大就盖多大。

Fragrant deer!

That's right, the brown-red figure in the bushes in front is the fragrant deer, also called the original musk deer. Li Qingshan never expected that the fragrant deer that he had been thinking about just now would appear in front of him.

However, this distance is slightly further.

"Brother Shan, do you want to use a gun?" Er Zhuang said honestly.

"Are you a tiger?"

Li Qingshan frowned and said: "After this shot, the fragrant deer will definitely be stressed. This thing is very timid. Once it is hit by the gun, it will be scared to death even if it is not dead. Even if you can't use the bow and arrow, don't use it!"

"If you want to capture this little thing alive, you have to use your brains and skills!"

As the saying goes, hunting a hundred deer is worse than one live musk deer. Many hunters can catch fragrant deer alive. However, after being captured alive and transported to the destination, the mortality rate still reaches 70%. The remaining 30% are estimated to have died at the destination. Except for a few that are released in the garden, they may still survive and be used for viewing.

"Brother Shan, how can you capture this thing alive without a bow, arrow, or gun?"

"Is it possible that we have to catch him alive?"

"We can't catch up, and Dahuang may not be able to catch up, right?"

Zhao Hongqi looked at the fragrant deer in the jungle and said.

"If you want to capture this little thing alive, you can use rope lasso, seine net, anesthesia, and cub luring. Among them, anesthesia to capture alive is the most troublesome and the most technical test. For some hunters, it is the most difficult method, but for a very small number of hunters, it is the most efficient method."

"As long as we can find the two traditional Chinese medicines Datura and Caowu in the old forest, boil them in proportions, and finally apply them on the rose plants that the fragrant deer loves to eat, the fragrant deer will faint as long as they eat it. Then we can just go and pick them up."

"The reason why I say this is the most difficult thing."

"The difficulty lies in the mixing of these two kinds of Chinese medicine, but I happen to be good at mixing them. Let's not disturb this fragrant deer. Since we found him near here, it means that his range of activities is also nearby. We will be well prepared in the past two days and try to find these two kinds of herbs. If it doesn't work, just use a lasso."

"We must capture this fragrant deer alive."

Li Qingshan said.

This is a big plan related to my own breeding farm, and it is also an important plan among several big plans in the past few years.

In addition, the most urgent need now is to change into well-fitting clothes for the whole family!

After all, food has been taken care of.

Build three more large tile-roofed houses, but the area of ​​these three large tile-roofed houses must be larger than those built by ordinary people. It is now 1957, and the state has not yet set any rigid regulations on the area of ​​​​homesteads. You can get approval, and as long as it is not too excessive, you can build as much as you want.
